name: geo-markers
title: Geo Markers
description: A geo-map layer of places: points in their group's colour and shape with optional names, or bubbles whose area is a number; each read by arrow keys and listed in a table.

meta.when: Marking sites, cities or events on a map, or comparing counts by place (bubbles: area, never radius, carries the number). For values that belong to whole regions use choropleth; for thousands of points use geo-hexbin. Goes inside geo-map.
meta.example:
<GeoMap label="Our stores" fit={country}>
  <GeoFeatures data={country} />
  <GeoMarkers
    label="Stores"
    points={[
      { id: "a", name: "Harbour", lon: 5.32, lat: 60.39, value: 120 },
      { id: "b", name: "Station", lon: 10.75, lat: 59.91, value: 340 },
    ]}
    variant="bubble"
    valueLabel="Visits"
  />
</GeoMap>
